description: This file defines a helper function bytesAsFloat32 that interprets a byte array as a 32-bit floating point number following IEEE 754-2008 standard. It handles special cases like NaN, Infinity, and distinguishes positive and negative zeros.

methods.name: bytesAsFloat32
methods.description: Converts an array of bytes into a 32-bit float following IEEE 754-2008 format, handling special cases for NaN, Infinity, and signed zeros.
